resolved_findings: Canonical spelling equality rejects duplicate-slash/dot aliases that could otherwise evade exact Git-tree key classification.
Lean .ilean artifacts are excluded explicitly even if valid UTF8 text.
Duplicate owner-group names and duplicate list-manifest paths are rejected.
Candidate own metadata folder cannot be included as owner-reviewed payload.
reviewed_guards: Only explicitly hash-pinned owner manifest/extra paths under research can be selected; selected regular files require canonical spelling and no symlink components.
Strict UTF8,5MiB cap,NUL exclusion and exact six credential patterns loaded from pinned canonical preflight apply to all selected payloads.
Base classification compares exact canonical paths and Git blob content with selected SHA, distinguishing identical,changed andnew files.
Selected bytes and file identity are rechecked; owner metadata/spec must remain pinned. HEAD,branch,raw index,index listing,policy andpreflight identities remain unchanged before/after generation.
Current progress is excluded unless root explicitly supplies the exact frozen canonical path SHA; no general mutable-progress permission is inferred.
Generated files use exclusive creation; script invokes only read-only Git operations and labels output as research candidate for root review, not proof or publication acceptance.
limits: No script execution,owner-spec acceptance,Git mutation or remote mutation was performed by this reviewer.
Final owner specification,finalized package evidence and eventual concrete selected path set remain separately reviewable inputs.
Candidate own metadata is intentionally outside selected owner payload; root must include and policy-review it explicitly if publishing it.
Coordinated nonhostile writers are assumed; terminal guard errors can leave unaccepted new output files. Root must require successful terminal execution and fresh exact-index review.
